scope: Authored synthetic requests against the same sixteen public products; no human conversion or unseen-catalog claim.

core.controls: Input ablations retain the observed query, budget and hard requirements. Combined controls use the same query gate and v5 query branch. Purchase-history-removed is report-only.

queryIntentGate.input: Same existing frozen-Qwen4096 query vector and exact request_text as v5; no background, history, person ID or private labels.
queryIntentGate.objective: Class-balanced binary cross entropy; fixed final step; TRAIN-only broad versus specific intent.
queryIntentGate.specificQueryRegression: Historical32 public queries across ten public profiles, with their actual merged constraints; preserve v5 semantics and exact-name guards. Report as development regression, not unseen evidence.

mechanicalRequirements: Exact native-versus-feature loss, logits and A/B gradients before fit and with actual learned weights after fit.
Measured target-free serving inference/cache-path parity; gradient-mode parity alone is insufficient.
All927 base tensors unchanged, real optimizer updates, checkpoint reload parity and immutable source/data pins.
All adapter/query-gate/control predictions frozen before private quality annotations are parsed.
No target, grade, teacher or dummy supervised weights in serving inputs or public feature metadata.
liveRequirements: Review all ten authored demo profiles at original and default browse queries; Bob's sofa context places a throw in the first three.
Real browser switching, query, cart, checkout and stale-response checks; source-bound variants and images; fresh neural copy.
Measure complete useful visible first-three readiness separately from full six-card completion, including decoded images and all required fresh copy.
Document actual cache eligibility, withheld/shortfall fields and failures; no physical-paint or human-conversion claim.
failurePolicy: Preserve failed attempts and do not lower thresholds or create an accepted/default serving profile without both offline and live acceptance.
